stories.title: Denver airport expecting extra busy weekend and increased passenger traffic to end month
stories.summary: Denver International Airport officials said projections this year outpace numbers from 2025.

stories.title: Woman killed in Thanksgiving Day crash involving elk in Colorado
stories.summary: A 63-year-old woman was killed, and four others were injured in a Thanksgiving Day crash involving an elk and two vehicles on Colorado Highway 13 near Meeker.

stories.title: Mild temps Friday as a winter storm moves into the mountains
stories.summary: Friday will be mild on the Front Range with highs in the 60's while winter storm warnings and advisories go into effect for the mountains at 5pm.

stories.title: Refrigerated truck helps Boulder food pantry keep up with growing demand
stories.summary: Harvest of Hope Pantry in Boulder is using a refrigerated truck to rescue more perishable food from grocery stores and reduce food waste.

stories.title: Voting on new Longmont city flag closes on Sunday
stories.summary: The designers of the finalist flags each received $1,000 for being chosen. The overall winner will receive another $1,500 award, the city said.

stories.title: How a group of Colorado Girl Scouts helped make Yule Marble the official state rock
stories.summary: Over 20 years ago, a troop of Colorado Girl Scouts led a successful effort to designate Yule Marble as the state's official rock.

stories.title: Black Friday e-bike deals: How Colorado parents can spot a motorcycle in disguise
stories.summary: Parents are urged to be cautious during Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales, as some vehicles marketed as e-bikes in Colorado may not meet legal standards.

stories.title: Colorado dance studio performing in rescheduled Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade after extending their stay
stories.summary: A Colorado dance team says they were able to extend their stay in New York City to perform in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, after it was postponed.

stories.title: Inclusive racing team kicks off annual Turkey Trot, as part of record-breaking crowd
stories.summary: Mile High United Way broke its own attendance record at this year's event.

stories.title: 'Very grateful on this Thanksgiving Day' | Woman in need of hip replacement to get surgery for free
stories.summary: When more than a year of hip pain sent her to the doctor, Jen Fynewever was told she'd need a hip replacement. Her doctor and Operation Walk USA are ready to help.

stories.title: Denver I-70 crash sends 3 people to the hospital Thanksgiving morning
stories.summary: The crash happened Thursday morning on Interstate 70 near Central Park Boulevard, according to Denver Police.

stories.title: Cheyenne Mountain Zoo welcomes new baby Lar Gibbon
stories.summary: The zoo announced the arrival of the newest gibbon on Thursday.
